title: The server refuses an inactive part on every add route, Admin included
custom_preconds: Admin token. Inactive part P1. An open WO with a part request; an open PO.
custom_steps:
1. POST /api/work-orders/part/make-request with P1 picked; then typed lower case as a vendor part; then as a special order
  2. POST /api/work-orders/part/change-request changing the request to P1; then re-saving its current part
  3. POST /api/inventory/orders/create, /add-item, /change-item and POST /api/orders/items/{id}/part-number with P1
  4. Resend a PO line's current number
  5. Deprecated POST /api/work-orders/parts/create with P1
custom_expected:
1. Each 400 {"errors":[{"error":"<P1> is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it."}]}; nothing created
  2. Change to P1 → 400; re-save current → 200
  3. Each 400; nothing created or changed
  4. Allowed
  5. 400 with the same message
